summary: 21 ranked local-first recommendations and planning leads for Thanksgiving weekend. Top picks are Fleet Feet's free Friday Donut Run/Winter Warriors kickoff; Prosser Thanksgiving in Wine Country; nearby holiday markets and local winery music. Regional endurance options include Seattle Ghost Marathon/50K and Capitol Forest Less Turkey More Trot. Winter conditions are unsettled: NWAC flags rain and high-elevation snowfall; Bluewood's official opening target is Dec 10. No verified regional motorcycle track day, local cyclocross race, or outdoor-adventure film screening this weekend. Individual registration, fees and weather must be rechecked close to departure; conditional/canceled calendar leads are explicitly labeled.
